description: Lignes du réseau de transport urbain - Communauté d'Agglomération de Moulins - 2023 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. Bus lines of the Moulins Community urban transport network. Coverage: Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. The portal shows the English title as "Urban transport network lines - Communauté d'Agglomération de Moulins - 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. Its keywords include lignes, open-data, donnees-ouvertes, transport, moulins, reseau. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
